name: Textalize MCP
description: Textalize helps users find their recorded meetings, review summaries and transcripts, inspect action items, decisions, and blockers, and browse meeting playlists through Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Textalize MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Textalize MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.textalize.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Textalize MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Textalize MCP provides these MCP tools: get_action_items, get_meeting_summary, get_meeting_transcript, list_meetings, list_playlist_meetings, list_playlists, list_upcoming_meetings, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Textalize MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Textalize MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Textalize MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Textalize MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Textalize MCP is developed by Textalize AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
